mutator.name: plan-003-uaf-llm01-objects-value
mutator.strategy: 50/50 weighted dispatch; default uses LLVMFuzzerMutate; a001 locates OBJECTS section, finds first group-code-0 record, replaces only its value line with an unrecognized object name while preserving group code line, line count, CRLF, and ENDSEC.

biases.code_hint: Only replace the value line following the first 0 group code in OBJECTS; keep the 0 group-code digits untouched; candidates FUZZ_OBJECT / AAAAAAAA / three DEL bytes; check MaxSize and memmove when length changes.
biases.basis: mutations[0]: target_part=value_line; operation=replace_value_line; field_id=record.value_after_group_code.0; locator.section_anchor=OBJECTS; new_value_policy.kind=unrecognized_object_name; preserve=[group_code_digits, record_line_count, CRLF, section_terminator(ENDSEC)]

limits: Plan only guarantees record-level location (record head group code + section anchor), not byte offsets; implementation searches line-by-line for OBJECTS then the first line whose trimmed content is exactly 0.
If the first group-code-0 value in OBJECTS is ENDSEC, the implementation returns the original input unchanged to preserve section_terminator(ENDSEC).
The candidate with three DEL bytes (0x7f 0x7f 0x7f) is supported; verify if non-printing bytes are acceptable in the target environment.
No strategy outside a001 is implemented; the default path remains LLVMFuzzerMutate.
If OBJECTS or a valid value_line cannot be found, or the replacement would exceed MaxSize, the function returns the original Size without modifying Data.
